name: Tremolo
description: Tremolo strokes: two or three slashes across the stem, telling the player to shake it.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(-32deg, 32deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 13%, transparent 13% 30%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 13%, transparent 13% 30%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
